articles.title: New £3.67 million Yorkshire Robotics Hub will help manufacturers bridge automation gap
articles.summary: The University of Bradford is leading a £3.67 million Yorkshire Robotics Adoption Hub after securing £2.75 million in funding from Innovate UK to help manufacturers adopt robotics and automation technologies.

articles.title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
articles.summary: What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play. Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment reminiscent of the movies Cast Away or Home Alone.

articles.title: QCraft partners with HERE Technologies to expand autonomous driving in Europe
articles.summary: QCraft, an autonomous driving technology company, signed a memorandum of understanding with HERE Technologies, a mapping and location data platform, at an event called HERE Directions 2026 in Munich.

articles.title: robot-data-diff: episode-aware diffs for LeRobot datasets
articles.summary: I built a small CLI for a problem I kept running into: you retrain a policy and it gets worse — was it the code or the data? robot-data-diff diffs any two revisions of a LeRobot dataset directly — local dirs or HF repo ids (v2.1 + v3.0).
